description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project aims to deliver lifesaving, multi-sectoral humanitarian assistance to conflict-affected internally displaced persons (IDPs) in Myawaddy Township (Kayin State). This location continues to face insecurity, mass displacement, and critical shortages of basic services. The project will address the most urgent needs of vulnerable populations through ltbgtFood Security, Shelter and Non-Food Items (NFI), WASH, and Protection interventions, lt/bgtdesigned to uphold dignity, resilience, and stability among affected families.ltbrgtAccording to RMO’s baseline assessment, nearly all displaced households left their homes unwillingly due to armed conflict and political instability. Many lost their livelihoods, homes, and household assets, and now reside in temporary sites, monasteries, or makeshift shelters with limited access to clean water, sanitation, and hygiene materials. Households are struggling to meet essential needs such as food, health costs, and children’s requirements. Women, children, elderly persons, and people with disabilities face additional vulnerabilities, including gender-based violence (GBV), human trafficking, and psychosocial distress.ltbrgtlt/pgtltulgtltligtltbgtIn place of MPCAlt/bgt, households will receive in-kind food distributions (rice, oil, salt, and other staple items) to ensure access to adequate nutrition.lt/ligtltligtEmergency shelter materials and NFI kits will be procured according to sector standards and distributed directly to beneficiaries. ltbgtThis replaces the previously planned cash-for-shelter and cash-for-NFI support.lt/bgtlt/ligtltligtDignity kits (including sanitary pads, underwear, and other essential items for women and girls) will be procured and distributed in-kind.lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgtImplementation will be led by Ratana Metta Organization (RMO), leveraging its strong field presence, experienced local staff. The project will align with the Myanmar Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP), cluster priorities, and humanitarian principles to ensure quality, accountability, and complementarity with other actors.ltbrgtThrough this intervention, RMO aims to enhance the well-being, protection, and resilience of conflict-affected IDPs, enabling them to recover with dignity and stability while reinforcing local capacities and coping mechanisms.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtlt/pgt
